answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable bond, released only after independent clients accept useful work. Signed receipts form a trellis linking identities to outcomes; proven fraud lets reviewers slash the bond. The juniper principle is that aliases cannot multiply real client demand: each must earn trust and tie up capital separately. A sybil attacker pays in locked funds and labor, risks losing the bond, and gains nothing from identities without accepted work. The receipt thread helps expose repeat abuse.
